Chilli_Cercospora.description: 🍂 Cercospora leaf spot causes small brown to gray spots on chilli leaves and may lead to premature leaf drop.
treatments: ✂️ Remove and safely discard badly infected leaves.
💦 Apply a suitable fungicide such as a copper-based product according to the product label.
🌬️ Improve air circulation and avoid overhead watering.
Chilli_Cercospora.home_remedy: 🏡 Remove fallen infected leaves and keep the area around the plant clean and dry.
Chilli_Cercospora.prevention: 🛡️ Use clean planting material, avoid wetting foliage, and inspect plants regularly.

Chilli_Mites_and_Thrips.description: 🕷️ Thrips and mites damage chilli leaves and young growth, causing curling, bronzing, stippling, or distorted leaves.
treatments: 🟨 Use yellow or blue sticky traps to monitor and reduce flying thrips.
🌿 Apply insecticidal soap or neem-based products according to the product label.
✂️ Remove severely damaged leaves and control weeds that can shelter pests.
Chilli_Mites_and_Thrips.home_remedy: 🏡 Gently wash the undersides of leaves with water to dislodge pests and repeat monitoring regularly.
Chilli_Mites_and_Thrips.prevention: 🛡️ Check young leaves and leaf undersides every week and avoid excessive nitrogen fertilization.

Chilli_Nutritional_Deficiency.description: 🌱 Nutritional deficiency can cause yellowing, poor growth, leaf discoloration, or abnormal development. The exact deficiency should be identified before applying a specific nutrient.
treatments: 🧪 Test the soil or growing medium to identify nutrient problems.
🌱 Apply a balanced fertilizer according to the soil-test result and product label.
💧 Maintain suitable watering and soil pH so nutrients can be absorbed properly.
Chilli_Nutritional_Deficiency.home_remedy: 🏡 Add well-decomposed compost in a moderate amount to improve soil organic matter.
Chilli_Nutritional_Deficiency.prevention: 🛡️ Use balanced nutrition, good-quality compost, and regular soil testing rather than applying excess fertilizer.

Healthy_Chili.description: 🌿 The chilli plant appears healthy, with normal green foliage and no obvious disease or pest symptoms.
treatments: 💧 Water regularly while avoiding waterlogging.
🌱 Provide balanced nutrition according to the crop and growing conditions.
✂️ Remove dead or damaged plant parts when needed.
Healthy_Chili.home_remedy: 🏡 Add a small amount of well-decomposed compost around the plant when appropriate.
Healthy_Chili.prevention: 🛡️ Inspect leaves, stems, and growing points every week for early signs of pests or disease.

botrytis_blightgray_mold.description: 🌫️ Botrytis blight, or gray mold, produces gray fuzzy growth on flowers, leaves, and stems, especially under cool and humid conditions.
treatments: ✂️ Remove infected flowers and leaves and discard them away from healthy plants.
💦 Apply an appropriate fungicide according to the product label when disease pressure is high.
🌬️ Reduce humidity and improve air circulation around the plant.
botrytis_blightgray_mold.home_remedy: 🏡 Remove dead flowers and plant debris promptly and keep foliage dry.
botrytis_blightgray_mold.prevention: 🛡️ Avoid prolonged leaf wetness, overwatering, and overcrowding.

healthy.description: 🌿 The hibiscus plant appears healthy, with normal green foliage and no obvious disease or pest symptoms.
treatments: 💧 Water regularly without keeping the soil waterlogged.
🌱 Provide balanced fertilizer according to plant needs.
✂️ Remove dry or damaged leaves when necessary.
healthy.home_remedy: 🏡 Add well-decomposed compost around the plant in moderation.
healthy.prevention: 🛡️ Inspect the plant weekly for early signs of disease or pests.

leaf_spot.description: 🍂 Leaf spot causes brown, black, or tan spots on leaves and may result in premature leaf drop.
treatments: ✂️ Remove badly infected leaves and fallen debris.
💦 Apply a suitable fungicide such as a copper-based product according to the product label.
🌬️ Improve air circulation and avoid overhead watering.
leaf_spot.home_remedy: 🏡 Keep infected leaves and fallen debris removed and water the soil rather than the foliage.
leaf_spot.prevention: 🛡️ Keep foliage dry, avoid overcrowding, and sanitize tools after working on infected plants.

mealybug_infestation.description: 🐛 Mealybugs are white, cotton-like insects that suck plant sap and can weaken plant growth.
treatments: ✂️ Remove heavily infested leaves or shoots.
🌿 Apply insecticidal soap or a neem-based product according to the product label.
🐞 Encourage natural predators and avoid unnecessary broad-spectrum insecticide use.
mealybug_infestation.home_remedy: 🏡 Gently wipe visible mealybugs with a cotton swab moistened with 70% rubbing alcohol, avoiding excessive application to tender foliage.
mealybug_infestation.prevention: 🛡️ Inspect new plants before introducing them and regularly check stems, leaf joints, and leaf undersides.

powdery_mildew.description: ⚪ Powdery mildew appears as a white powder-like coating on leaves and shoots and can reduce plant growth.
treatments: ✂️ Remove badly infected leaves and shoots.
💦 Apply a labeled fungicide such as sulfur or potassium bicarbonate where appropriate.
☀️ Improve sunlight exposure and air movement around the plant.
powdery_mildew.home_remedy: 🏡 Remove infected material and improve airflow; avoid keeping foliage wet for long periods.
powdery_mildew.prevention: 🛡️ Avoid overcrowding and excessive nitrogen fertilization and monitor new growth regularly.

rust.description: 🟠 Rust causes orange, yellow, or reddish-brown spore-producing spots, often on the underside of leaves.
treatments: ✂️ Remove severely infected leaves.
💦 Apply a suitable fungicide according to the product label when needed.
🍂 Collect and discard fallen infected leaves.
rust.home_remedy: 🏡 Keep foliage dry and remove infected and fallen leaves promptly.
rust.prevention: 🛡️ Provide good air circulation, avoid overhead irrigation, and inspect leaf undersides regularly.

sooty_mold.description: ⚫ Sooty mold forms a black coating on leaves and commonly develops on sticky honeydew produced by sap-sucking insects.
treatments: 🐞 Control the underlying insects such as whiteflies, aphids, or mealybugs.
🌿 Use insecticidal soap or a neem-based product according to the product label.
💦 Gently wash the affected leaves with clean water after the pest problem is addressed.
sooty_mold.home_remedy: 🏡 Wash leaves gently with water and mild soap, then rinse with clean water; focus on controlling the insects causing honeydew.
sooty_mold.prevention: 🛡️ Inspect plants regularly and control sap-sucking pests before heavy honeydew buildup occurs.

whitefly_infestation.description: 🪰 Whiteflies are small sap-sucking insects that can cause yellowing, curling, weak growth, and honeydew buildup.
treatments: 🟨 Use yellow sticky traps for monitoring and reducing adult whiteflies.
🌿 Apply insecticidal soap or a neem-based product according to the product label.
✂️ Remove severely infested leaves when practical.
whitefly_infestation.home_remedy: 🏡 Gently wash the undersides of leaves with water and repeat monitoring frequently.
whitefly_infestation.prevention: 🛡️ Check the undersides of leaves weekly and remove heavily infested plant material.

Bacterial_Spot.description: 🦠 Bacterial spot causes small dark water-soaked or brown lesions on tomato leaves and fruit.
treatments: ✂️ Remove severely infected leaves and fruit and dispose of them safely.
💦 Use a labeled copper-based bactericide where appropriate to help suppress disease.
🌬️ Avoid overhead irrigation and improve air circulation.
Bacterial_Spot.home_remedy: 🏡 Remove infected debris and avoid handling wet plants to reduce spread.
Bacterial_Spot.prevention: 🛡️ Use clean seed or transplants, sanitize tools, avoid overhead watering, and rotate crops.

Early_Blight.description: 🍂 Early blight causes brown target-like lesions with concentric rings and can lead to yellowing and leaf loss.
treatments: ✂️ Remove lower infected leaves and fallen plant debris.
💦 Apply a suitable fungicide according to the product label when necessary.
🌬️ Improve airflow and avoid prolonged leaf wetness.
Early_Blight.home_remedy: 🏡 Remove infected leaves and keep the soil surface free of diseased plant debris.
Early_Blight.prevention: 🛡️ Mulch the soil, avoid overhead watering, provide adequate spacing, and rotate crops.

Healthy.description: 🌿 The tomato plant appears healthy, with normal green foliage and no obvious disease or pest symptoms.
treatments: 💧 Water consistently while avoiding waterlogging.
🌱 Provide balanced nutrition according to crop needs.
✂️ Remove dead or damaged plant parts and maintain good plant support.
Healthy.home_remedy: 🏡 Use well-decomposed compost in moderation to support soil health.
Healthy.prevention: 🛡️ Inspect leaves and stems weekly and maintain good spacing, sanitation, and watering practices.

Late_Blight.description: 🌧️ Late blight can cause rapidly enlarging dark lesions on leaves and stems and may severely damage tomato plants under cool, wet conditions.
treatments: ✂️ Remove and safely dispose of heavily infected plant material.
💦 Apply an appropriate labeled fungicide or fungicide mixture as soon as disease is detected.
🌬️ Improve air circulation and reduce prolonged leaf wetness.
Late_Blight.home_remedy: 🏡 Remove infected material promptly and avoid overhead watering; home remedies should not be relied on for severe outbreaks.
Late_Blight.prevention: 🛡️ Use healthy planting material, avoid prolonged leaf wetness, provide spacing, and monitor during cool wet weather.

Leaf_Mold.description: 🍃 Tomato leaf mold commonly produces yellow patches on the upper leaf surface and olive-green to gray mold on the underside, especially in humid conditions.
treatments: ✂️ Remove severely infected leaves.
💦 Apply a suitable fungicide according to the product label when required.
🌬️ Reduce humidity and improve ventilation around the plants.
Leaf_Mold.home_remedy: 🏡 Remove affected leaves and increase ventilation; avoid wetting foliage.
Leaf_Mold.prevention: 🛡️ Maintain good airflow, avoid excessive humidity, and water at the soil level.

Septoria_Leaf_Spot.description: 🍂 Septoria leaf spot produces many small circular spots with dark margins and pale centers, often beginning on lower leaves.
treatments: ✂️ Remove infected lower leaves and plant debris.
💦 Apply a suitable fungicide according to the product label when needed.
🌬️ Improve air circulation and avoid overhead watering.
Septoria_Leaf_Spot.home_remedy: 🏡 Remove infected leaves and keep fallen debris away from the base of the plant.
Septoria_Leaf_Spot.prevention: 🛡️ Use mulch, avoid splashing soil onto leaves, sanitize tools, and rotate crops.

Target_Spot.description: 🎯 Target spot produces circular brown lesions that may develop concentric rings on tomato leaves and fruit.
treatments: ✂️ Remove severely affected leaves and fruit.
💦 Apply a suitable labeled fungicide when necessary.
🌬️ Improve airflow and reduce prolonged leaf wetness.
Target_Spot.home_remedy: 🏡 Remove diseased debris and keep foliage as dry as practical.
Target_Spot.prevention: 🛡️ Provide adequate spacing, avoid overhead irrigation, and rotate crops.

Tomato_Mosaic_Virus.description: 🦠 Tomato mosaic virus can cause mottled or mosaic-like green patterns, distorted leaves, and reduced plant growth. There is no reliable cure for an infected plant.
treatments: ✂️ Remove and safely discard severely infected plants to reduce spread.
🧼 Wash hands and disinfect tools after handling suspected infected plants.
🌱 Use certified virus-free seed or transplants for replacement plants.
Tomato_Mosaic_Virus.home_remedy: 🏡 There is no dependable household cure; prioritize sanitation and removal of infected material.
Tomato_Mosaic_Virus.prevention: 🛡️ Avoid tobacco contamination, sanitize tools and hands, and use clean seed and planting material.

Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.description: 🦠 Tomato yellow leaf curl virus causes upward leaf curling, yellowing, stunting, and reduced fruit production. It is commonly spread by whiteflies.
treatments: ✂️ Remove severely infected plants where appropriate to reduce virus sources.
🪰 Control whiteflies using traps and suitable labeled insect-control products.
🌱 Replace plants with healthy, virus-free transplants when necessary.
Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.home_remedy: 🏡 Remove heavily infected plants and use yellow sticky traps to monitor whiteflies.
Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.prevention: 🛡️ Control whiteflies early, use resistant varieties where available, remove weeds, and use healthy transplants.
